title: Multi-Request Comparator Lens — compact diff view for related failed requests
creator: Aria Gomez
description: Problem: When investigating correlated failed requests (retries, fallback to variants, or region-based divergences), engineers today open multiple request cards and toggle between traces. This is slow and error-prone for high-volume customers. Goal: design a compact, side-by-side comparator lens in the Console that surfaces the key deltas across N related requests (config, model variant, KV cache state, routing decision, token counts, and final error taxonomy) and lets an investigator quickly escalate, group, or create a correlated incident view. Scope: design a visual pattern that (1) accepts a selected set of related requests (from trace, query, or search), (2) renders a compact aligned timeline per request, (3) highlights deltas (color-coded) across request metadata and payloads, (4) exposes quick actions (retry single request, retry all, open in full request inspector, attach to incident), and (5) supports keyboard-first navigation and accessibility. Out of scope: backend correlation algorithm and trace search API (ENG). Constraints: must render smoothly for up to 8 requests side-by-side; avoid sending full payloads to the client when large (lazy-load); respect data retention / redaction rules for PII. Design artifacts linked below include two prototypes (compact grid and stacked diff ribbon) and a micro-interaction spec for the quick-action menu.
acceptance_criteria: Selectable from request list, trace detail, or search results
Delta indicators for model variant, region, status code, latency, and token delta
Compact timeline aligned across requests with hover-expansion for payload snippets
Quick actions: Retry, Open in Inspector, Create Correlated Incident
No client performance regression when loading up to 8 compact columns; lazy-load payloads beyond 2 KB
